About this item

  • Unapologetic power: Area-51 was intentionally designed to reach new performance horizons by enabling higher graphics and processor power limits.
  • Game changing graphics: Designed to push boundaries, RTX 5070Ti with NVIDIA Max-Q delivers optimized battery life and performance and jaw-dropping graphics fidelity—perfect for those who demand the extraordinary on the go.
  • Intelligent processing: Intel Core Ultra HX processors integrate CPU, built-in GPU, and NPU into a single package designed for AI acceleration and balanced performance across your favorite things to do.
  • Introducing the Cryo-Chamber: The Cryo-Chamber props up the laptop and introduces a much larger air intake, promoting increased airflow, and features a clear Gorilla Glass panel* providing a view of the AlienFX fans.
  • Advanced dynamic lighting: Ambient AlienFX lighting inspired by the aurora borealis takes on color and movement which reflects across surfaces to create an other-worldly experience.
  • Dell Services: 1 Year Onsite Service provides support when and where you need it. Dell will come to your home, office, or location of choice, if an issue covered by Limited Hardware Warranty cannot be resolved remotely.

Amazon.com Return Policy:You may return any new computer purchased from Amazon.com that is "dead on arrival," arrives in damaged condition, or is still in unopened boxes, for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Amazon.com reserves the right to test "dead on arrival" returns and impose a customer fee equal to 15 percent of the product sales price if the customer misrepresents the condition of the product. Any returned computer that is damaged through customer misuse, is missing parts, or is in unsellable condition due to customer tampering will result in the customer being charged a higher restocking fee based on the condition of the product. Product Description

The new performance precedent. Alienware Area-51 gaming laptops are engineered for maximum power, packed with innovation, and encased in other-worldly design. By fusing an advanced thermal strategy, increasing airflow and elevating power with Intel Core Ultra HX processors and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070Ti Laptop GPUs, we're bringing alien-class performance to the most passionate gamers.

    Play the latest games with graphics that rival reality. Play with players on console. Play with the peripherals that you love. When it comes to playing your way, Windows 11 makes it happen.

  1. The new performance precedent


    Alienware Area-51 gaming laptops are engineered for maximum power, packed with innovation, and encased in otherworldly design. By fusing an advanced thermal strategy, increasing airflow and elevating power with Intel Core Ultra HX processors and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series Laptop GPUs, we're bringing alien-class performance to the most passionate gamers.

  2. Unapologetic power


    Area-51 was intentionally designed to reach new performance horizons by enabling higher graphics and processor power limits. With more power provided to the silicon components, gamers can run their games on the highest settings, making this our most powerful 16" gaming laptop yet.

    Up to 65W: CPU Thermal Design Power means full power devoted towards processing tasks in real-time.

    Based on internal Dell analysis, December 2024.

  3. Game changing graphics


    Step into the future of gaming and creation with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series Laptop GPUs, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell and AI. Designed to push boundaries, RTX 50 Series with NVIDIA Max-Q delivers optimized battery life and performance and jaw-dropping graphics fidelity—perfect for those who demand the extraordinary on the go.

    Ray Tracing Redefined: Experience cinematic realism with full ray tracing.

    AI-Boosted Gameplay: Unleash next-level performance and image quality with DLSS 4.

  4. Intelligent processing


    Intel Core Ultra HX processors integrate CPU, built-in GPU, and NPU into a single package designed for AI acceleration and balanced performance across your favorite things to do.

    CPU: Ensures everything runs smoothly and as expected; like controlling non-player characters.

    NPU: Uses AI with compatible livestreaming software to remove your background thus offloading this performance demand from the CPU or GPU.

    iGPU: Delivers graphics rendering capabilities and imagery editing power at home.

  5. Supercharged data stream


    Multitasking for Gamers and Creators: With two SO-DIMM slots designated for DDR5 system memory, Area-51 laptops can support up to 64GB of memory.

    Subject to third party purchase of additional memory.

  1. Introducing the Cryo-Chamber


    Developed by our engineers, Area-51’s new Cryo-Chamber structure, located at the bottom of the laptop, focuses air to the core components where it matters the most. The Cryo-Chamber props up the laptop and introduces a much larger air intake, promoting increased airflow, and features a clear Gorilla Glass panel providing a view of the AlienFX fans.

    Gorilla Glass panels on the Cryo-Chamber require a configuration with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti or higher.

    The video showcases the product in use.The video guides you through product setup.The video compares multiple products.The video shows the product being unpacked.

    Cryo Cooling

    Merchant Video

  2. Performance Driven Thermals


    Marathon gaming requires absolute power. Our advanced cooling technology, Alienware Cryo-tech, is designed to maintain system stability even during the most demanding sessions.

  3. Quad fans


    Helps increase total airflow and pressurizes the chassis, keeping even the most aggressive hotspots properly cooled.

    Available on configurations with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti and above.

  4. More copper, less heat


    With up to 3x more copper in weight than previous 16" laptops and a vapor chamber 40% larger, Alienware 16 Area-51 dynamically balances heat across up to 7 heat pipes making it our most performance forward 16" laptop to date.

    Based on internal Dell analysis, December 2024.

  5. Element 31 thermal interface


    Encapsulated gallium-silicone across the CPU, dissipates heat faster, allowing you to take on marathon gaming sessions with ease.

  1. The video showcases the product in use.The video guides you through product setup.The video compares multiple products.The video shows the product being unpacked.

    AW lighting

    Merchant Video

    Advanced dynamic lighting


    Ambient AlienFX lighting inspired by the aurora borealis takes on color and movement which reflects across surfaces to create an otherworldly experience. The masterful layering of materials marks a new level of technical ability and design sophistication.

  2. Zero hinge innovation


    A more robust closure and nearly invisible hinge creates a floating display. Engineered for strength and sophistication this patent pending design drives motion in the radial direction and telescopes out, enabling an adaptive rear design that features translucent materials and new AlienFX lighting.

    The video showcases the product in use.The video guides you through product setup.The video compares multiple products.The video shows the product being unpacked.

    AW hinge

    Merchant Video

  3. Bringing comfort to the forefront


    Our new Area-51 laptops combine mystery and otherworldly design with fluid contours and soft surfaces that inspires comfortable gameplay for hours.

    Contours: Fluid design contours with thoughtful edges provide enhanced tactile feeling.

    V-Rail edges: Easy and comfortable open and closing for the lid of your laptop.

    Pillowed palm rest: Seamless pillowed palm rest redefines comfort during any gaming session.

  4. Next-gen hardware in every aspect


    Incredible Battery: A larger 96WHr Lithium Ion battery enables fast charging and uses Alienware Battery Defender technology to optimize power consumption.

    Powerful Webcam: A new 8MP 4K HDR webcam delivers incredible resolution and clarity.

    Superior Wi-Fi: Area-51 laptops come standard with Wi-Fi 7 technology ensuring high peak rates and low latency across multiple connections.

    Versatile Thunderbolt: New Thunderbolt 5 technology provides the best connectivity to all your external devices.

  5. Total Command


    Control more than ever with Alienware Command Center.

    Convenient presets: Maximize your gameplay with performance presets for the power you need.

    Performance overlay: Manage and see CPU, GPU, memory and thermals stats without exiting the game.

    AlienFX: Customize your set up with lighting settings that extend to all your Alienware accessories.

    AlienVision: Toggle external Alienware monitor hardware-based overlays on/off to help you focus on the targets at hand.

  6. Windows Copilot Key


    With one click, you have instant access to Copilot in Windows – Your own personal AI assistant. Get real answers, inspiration and solutions at your fingertips.

    Copilot in Windows availability depends on local government regulation. For regions where Copilot is not available, pressing the Copilot key will bring up the Windows search menu.

    • Jonathan B
      5.0 out of 5 stars Fantastic laptop and good value
      Reviewed in the United States on October 26, 2025
      CPU: Intel Core Ultra 9-275HXRAM Size: 32 GBCapacity: 16-inchesStyle: RTX 5070TIVerified Purchase
      Alienware seems to really gotten their act together recently. This laptop is beautiful, has a great high-quality feel to all the materials including the keyboard, and yet it’s actually a pretty good value given the performance specs. The only thing I can possibly complain about is the screen isn’t the highest quality. It’s got great frame rate, and nice color, but the contrast isn’t great, and the uniformity of blacks is pretty poor. I really wish Alienware would offer an OLED screen on what is supposed to be their flagship laptop, but that’s only a minor complaint. I’d certainly be happy to pay more to get a better screen, but at this price point the screen quality is acceptable.

      The thermals are much improved over the prior generation. There’s only so much they can do because they insist on using Intel processors, but they’ve done a nice job with the cooling on this one. Unless you’re playing a game you won’t even notice the fan, and when you are it’s not nearly as loud as the prior generation, and the laptop itself doesn’t get as hot.

      Lastly, the performance: absolutely amazing for a laptop. Especially at this price. I could run Forza 5 at the highest settings and hit 240 frames a second. Just fantastic performance for something you can take with you.

      The Alienware was too loud and too heavy.
